While it carries over Scene 48 (costing ₹60,000) and incurs 60 minutes of overtime (costing ₹7,500), it successfully shoots Scene 42 within the rooftop's availability window (until 20:30) and captures the sunset/golden hour (17:45–19:15) creatively.
